translation: Its last segment is called the weilü (尾閭), also called the diduan (骶端), also called the juegu (橛骨), also called the qionggu (窮骨), commonly called the weichun (尾椿). If it is swollen from squatting and being pressed, it must connect to the lumbar and hip; administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, wash with Haitongpi Tang (Erythrina Bark Decoction, 海桐皮湯), and apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏). <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> (seen in the injury of the vertex) <ins>Haitongpi Tang</ins> (seen in the injury of the two cheekbones) <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> (seen in the injury of the vertex bone) (the above are seen in the back bone figure).
